policy: Anticipatory entries are capped PROBE decisions. They never authorize ADD/BUY, never bypass confirmation, and risk at most 0.25% of portfolio value per candidate.

caveats: close-only paths cannot resolve intraday order when both levels trade the same day
earnings dates unavailable and therefore not modeled
probabilities describe historical cohorts, not guarantees
